text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Opposition leader calls on government to be clear in policy statements. Eddie Fenech Adami said the government lacked a vision, had been unprepared to govern and was groping in the dark.

- New Labour government is still considering what to do about a $150 million hospital project initialled by the former Nationalist Government. Engineers had warned former government of bad workmanship.
IN-NAZZJON - Parliament gets down to business today after
formally opening on Thursday, with an address by the president who outlined the government's agenda.
- Malta Drydocks facing difficulties, with only four ships at the dockyard.
